tools.name: start_transcription
tools.description: Prepare MyClawn Transcribe for this request. Returns a link to transcribe.myclawn.com with the request already filled in; the user uploads their files there. Needs no account and takes no files here. Upload audio or video. Get a clean transcript with speakers, timestamps and proper punctuation, in W

tools.name: about
tools.description: What MyClawn Transcribe does, what the user gets, how it works and what it does not do, in the site's own words.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_transcription · Private data: start_transcription · Public sink: start_transcription.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_transcription · Private data: start_transcription · Public sink: start_transcription

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
